conversation.text: How may I help you today?
What services do you offer?

We offer the following services:
- General Consultation
- Dental Checkup
- Dental Cleaning
- Lab Tests:
  - Malaria Test
  - Blood Sugar Test
  - Typhoid Test
  - Urine Test
- Child Vaccination
- Family Planning
- Wound Dressing
- Home Visits
Where are you located?
We are located in Westlands, Nairobi, next to Naivas Supermarket on the 2nd Floor. Open Mon-Fri 8AM-6PM, Sat 9AM-2PM, closed Sunday. Do you want to book?
Yes, I would like to book a general consultation.

Do you have a preferred doctor?
Dr Nancy (Monday-Friday, 9 AM-1 PM), Dr Otieno (Monday-Friday, 2 PM-6 PM), or no preference?
Dr Nancy, please
What date would you prefer? Please use DD/MM/YYYY.
What time would you prefer? For example, 10:00 AM.
Thank you. May I have the patient's full name?
Jane Doe
Thank you. What phone number can the clinic use to contact you?

Please review your appointment request:

Name: Jane Doe
Phone: 0700000000
Service: General consultation
Doctor: Dr Nancy
Date: 2026-12-01
Time: 10:00 AM

Would you like me to submit this request? Please reply YES or NO.
Yes

Your appointment has been successfully confirmed!

Appointment ID: HHC-11ADA104
Name: Jane Doe
Service: General consultation
Healthcare provider: Dr Nancy
Date: 01 December 2026
Time: 10:00 AM

Please arrive at least 15 minutes before your appointment.
We look forward to seeing you at Hope Clinic!
Which doctor did I choose and what date is my appointment?
You chose Dr Nancy for your general consultation on 01 December 2026 at 10:00 AM. Do you want to book another appointment or need more info?
No, thank you. That's all.
Thank you! If you need help later, just reach out. Have a good day!
